report.battery_basis: Each 37 x 25.5 x 5.2 mm envelope uses DTP502535 published maximum pack dimensions. Two 400 mAh cells suggest an 800 mAh target, but a matched supplier-built 1S2P assembly is unselected. Do not parallel two retail protected packs.
report.single_rectangular_alternative: A single 37 x 25.5 mm envelope fits the same upper battery bay; no larger stocked single pack has been selected. One continuous L cell requires custom tooling/quotation.
